profiles.label: SilverScript latest (14dce9a)
notes: Includes c1ed163 entrypoint, constant-cycle and bounded-loop hardening
Rejects declaration shadowing and attempts to override compiler builtins
Makes struct assignment atomic and struct-field lowering collision resistant
Fixes ternary lowering, struct append, bool array normalization and split result typing
Requires fixed byte arrays of at most eight bytes for int(byte[N]) casts
Keeps loop iteration variables immutable

profiles.label: SilverScript Studio 0.2.8 (6f9e078)
notes: Retained to reproduce Studio 0.2.8 projects
Uses entry syntax for public entrypoints
Exposes transaction introspection as outpointTxId
Uses checkMsgSig for arbitrary-message signatures
Compiler JSON calls the emitted program bytecode
Rejects duplicate function names and entry parameters that shadow contract fields
Restricts ordered comparisons to numeric operands
Adds the variable-input g16.verify Groth16 verifier builtin
Requires explicit signed(byte) or unsigned(byte) scalar conversion
Uses value as byte for checked runtime integer-to-byte conversion

profiles.label: SilverScript Studio 0.2.7 (cb34aa5)
notes: Retained to reproduce Studio 0.2.7 projects

breakingChanges.messageZh: 公开入口语法已从 entrypoint function 改为 entry。
breakingChanges.messageEn: Public entrypoint syntax changed from entrypoint function to entry.

breakingChanges.messageZh: 任意消息签名内建函数已改名为 checkMsgSig。
breakingChanges.messageEn: The arbitrary-message signature builtin was renamed to checkMsgSig.

breakingChanges.messageZh: 输入 outpoint 字段已改名为 outpointTxId。
breakingChanges.messageEn: The input outpoint field was renamed to outpointTxId.

breakingChanges.messageZh: .reverse() 已删除，必须显式重写字节顺序逻辑并重新测试。
breakingChanges.messageEn: .reverse() was removed; rewrite byte ordering explicitly and retest it.

breakingChanges.messageZh: 编译产物 JSON 字段由 script 改为 bytecode；外部工具必须兼容两个字段。
breakingChanges.messageEn: The compiler artifact JSON field changed from script to bytecode; integrations must support both.

breakingChanges.messageZh: 位运算现在仅接受 bytes；请人工确认操作数类型。
breakingChanges.messageEn: Bitwise operators now accept bytes only; review operand types manually.

breakingChanges.messageZh: 编译器现在禁止构造参数、字段、常量、函数参数和局部变量之间的名称遮蔽；请通过完整编译定位并重命名冲突声明。
breakingChanges.messageEn: The compiler now rejects name shadowing across constructor parameters, fields, constants, function parameters and locals; fully compile and rename conflicting declarations.

breakingChanges.messageZh: .split() 结果现在会推断固定左侧长度；请复核显式类型、析构赋值和下游状态编码。
breakingChanges.messageEn: .split() now infers a fixed left-side length; review explicit types, tuple destructuring and downstream state encoding.

breakingChanges.messageZh: for 循环迭代变量现在不可修改；请使用独立局部变量表达循环内状态。
breakingChanges.messageEn: For-loop iteration variables are now immutable; use a separate local for mutable loop state.

breakingChanges.messageZh: 编译器将 max_iterations 限制为 10,000；请缩小循环边界并重新评估脚本单位。
breakingChanges.messageEn: The compiler caps max_iterations at 10,000; reduce the bound and reassess script units.
